missions.title: ARTEMIS Eclipse — Evidence-Age Mission Control
missions.hypothesis: Scheduling evidence refresh by expected decision loss yields better assurance within a fixed observation budget.
missions.model: Each claim has age a, refresh cost c and loss l(a); select refresh actions to minimize sum l(a) subject to budget. The age-to-loss relation is an elicited assumption until evaluated.
missions.experiment: Simulate claim changes, stale evidence and imperfect refresh tools; compare periodic and loss-prioritized refresh at identical analyst-hour budgets.
missions.challenges: Refresh failure; correlated claim changes; misleading freshness; tool unavailable.
missions.falsifier: Refute if targeted refresh raises false acceptance or cannot outperform fixed refresh across plausible age-to-loss curves.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: DART Sentinel — Revocation Refinement Proof
missions.hypothesis: A refinement relation can expose mismatches between abstract revocation policy and a cached implementation.
missions.model: Define abstract permissions P and concrete cache C; prove implementation steps simulate policy steps while bounding stale grants by Delta. Safety and eventual revocation are separate properties.
missions.experiment: Enumerate finite users, two replicas and delayed benign messages; compare a direct state model with implementation traces from an owned reference interpreter.
missions.challenges: Unbounded delay; restart forgetting expiry; clock rollback; fairness violated.
missions.falsifier: Refute when a reachable permitted action lacks an abstract authorization witness; successful finite exploration does not prove the unbounded system.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: LUCY Atlas — Proof Assumption Debt
missions.hypothesis: Tracking dependencies between assumptions and proofs reduces misleading assurance after configuration changes.
missions.model: Use bipartite proof/assumption graph; invalidated assumption removes confidence from every dependent claim. Compute minimal assumption cut sets but never equate graph reachability with theorem validity.
missions.experiment: Version a small protocol specification; vary queue bounds, scheduling fairness and clock monotonicity. Compare manual proof review with explicit invalidation reports.
missions.challenges: Hidden axioms; proof tool version changes; wrong environment abstraction.
missions.falsifier: Refute if reviewers fail to detect invalidated critical claims or generated warnings overwhelm the original workflow.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: ORION Lifeboat — Power-Loss Recovery Lattice
missions.hypothesis: Exhaustive interruption-point analysis can distinguish staged-image recovery from assumed update atomicity.
missions.model: Represent old, staged, verified and committed image states with metadata consistency predicates. Enumerate reset transitions and check that a previously verified image remains selectable.
missions.experiment: Implement a storage-only emulator, vary write ordering and simulate interruption after each write. Compare two-slot commit with single-slot overwrite.
missions.challenges: Both images share failed storage; metadata damage; rollback prohibition; verification error.
missions.falsifier: Refute if any enumerated reset leads to no approved image, or recovery relies on an undeclared persistent field.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: Psyche Witness — Sensor Agreement Under Drift
missions.hypothesis: Cross-sensor agreement with explicit calibration uncertainty reduces false fault labels relative to fixed residual limits.
missions.model: Fit latent state x with y_i=H_i x+b_i+epsilon_i; separate slowly varying bias b_i from abrupt disagreement. Identifiability requires redundancy or an independent reference.
missions.experiment: Replay synthetic thermal drift and missing channels; then use consenting owned-board measurements with traceable reference calibration.
missions.challenges: Shared calibration error; common-mode supply change; probe loading; reference drift.
missions.falsifier: Refute if the method accepts a common-mode discrepancy or rejects benign drift more often at matched detection sensitivity.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: VOYAGER Passport — Evidence Decay in Dependencies
missions.hypothesis: Expired provenance evidence changes remediation decisions independently of component age.
missions.model: Model artifact identity, build evidence and policy validity as separate graph attributes; rank unverified edges without assigning invented vulnerability probabilities.
missions.experiment: Generate versioned synthetic SBOMs and provenance statements; hold out ecosystem names and ambiguous version ranges. Compare flat inventory checks with identity-bound validation.
missions.challenges: Version aliases; absent dependency edges; legitimate unsigned artifacts; transparency service loss.
missions.falsifier: Refute if freshness metadata only redistributes warnings without improving adjudicated decision accuracy.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: OSIRIS Ledger — Build Reproducibility Causality
missions.hypothesis: Environment control explains a measurable portion of nondeterministic artifact differences.
missions.model: Use factorial factors for timestamp, locale, compiler version and dependency lock; outcome is digest equality plus semantic artifact difference. Separate exact reproducibility from correctness.
missions.experiment: Build an owned minimal application repeatedly in controlled environments; randomize factor order and freeze inputs. Compare locked and unlocked dependency setups.
missions.challenges: Nondeterministic linker; embedded timestamps; cache contamination; compiler change.
missions.falsifier: Refute if claimed factor effects disappear on repeated clean builds or binary equality is reported as functional assurance.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: KEPLER Nightwatch — Rare-Event Calibration
missions.hypothesis: A detector selected at realistic prevalence respects analyst alert capacity better than one selected by accuracy.
missions.model: PPV = sensitivity*pi/[sensitivity*pi + FPR*(1-pi)]. Estimate pi separately; evaluate event recall and false alerts per sensor-hour across temporal blocks.
missions.experiment: Run the supplied offline detector benchmark, then evaluate public LANL aggregates after access and schema review. Freeze thresholds on validation data; test prevalence reductions.
missions.challenges: Concept drift; missing telemetry; clustered events; delayed labels.
missions.falsifier: Refute if the detector exceeds the preregistered alert budget or gains vanish after time-block splitting.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: EUROPA Clock — Interval-Coherent Telemetry
missions.hypothesis: Interval timestamps reduce false causal ordering across partially synchronized observers.
missions.model: Assign each event an offset-bound interval; establish a partial order only for disjoint intervals and preserve ambiguity instead of forcing ties.
missions.experiment: Generate shared benign events across four synthetic clocks with offset and drift. Compare timestamp sort with interval order against hidden ground truth.
missions.challenges: Bounds too narrow; reference clock lost; asymmetric network delay; duplicated event.
missions.falsifier: Refute if actual timing lies outside declared bounds or ordering precision falls below direct sorting at equal coverage.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: OSIRIS-REx Prism — Acquisition Coverage Bounds
missions.hypothesis: Coverage-aware negative-evidence statements are more accurate than treating absent artifacts as nonoccurrence.
missions.model: Define observation opportunity O and event E; missing record does not identify P(E) without P(record|E,O). Report bounds when capture probability is uncertain.
missions.experiment: Create synthetic cases with known ground truth and independent missing blocks. Ask blinded reviewers to assess conclusions with and without coverage maps.
missions.challenges: Event-dependent missingness; overwritten buffer; parser failure; acquisition changing state.
missions.falsifier: Refute if confidence remains high when the relevant observation opportunity is absent.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: STARDUST Ledger — Reproducible Inference Graph
missions.hypothesis: Explicit intermediate artifacts allow independent analysts to reproduce conclusions with fewer unsupported steps.
missions.model: Directed graph nodes bind input hashes, parser versions, derived facts and hypotheses; causal arrows require evidence beyond timestamp adjacency.
missions.experiment: Use synthetic fixtures and selected CFReDS records; compare narrative reports with executable, read-only transformation manifests.
missions.challenges: Tool-version mismatch; lossy export; ambiguous transformation; stale case annotations.
missions.falsifier: Refute if identical declared inputs produce unexplained different conclusions or reviewers cannot distinguish facts from hypotheses.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: ARTEMIS Keyring — Revocation Under Blackout
missions.hypothesis: Explicit offline validity bounds reduce stale authority while quantifying denied legitimate work.
missions.model: Lease lifetime tau trades stale-grant window against task availability during disconnect; optimize declared costs under bounded time error.
missions.experiment: Synthetic task/identity graph with intermittent contact; compare short leases, periodic review and event-based revocation.
missions.challenges: Clock uncertainty; emergency authority; delegated grant; unusually long disconnection.
missions.falsifier: Refute if a policy exceeds its declared stale-authority bound or denial cost dominates every comparable baseline.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: LUNAR Veil — Utility-Bounded Private Aggregation
missions.hypothesis: Separating contribution bounds from privacy accounting reveals when telemetry utility claims are unsupported.
missions.model: For user-level count sensitivity Delta and epsilon, Laplace scale b=Delta/epsilon. Repeated releases require composition; entity adjacency and clipping determine Delta.
missions.experiment: Use the supplied analytic privacy tradeoff and synthetic grouped counts; evaluate absolute error, subgroup error and release count. No production identifiers are needed.
missions.challenges: Unbounded contributions; small cohorts; adaptive repeated releases; wrong privacy unit.
missions.falsifier: Refute if the claimed guarantee omits composition or usefulness disappears at the stated contribution bound.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: GEMINI Anchor — Backup-Key Dependency Twin
missions.hypothesis: Backup recovery studies that include identity and key dependencies identify otherwise hidden restoration failures.
missions.model: Construct prerequisite graph of snapshots, keys, authority and service state; restore is feasible only when prerequisites are both available and validated.
missions.experiment: Synthetic region and identity outages with paired backup architectures; compare snapshot-only success checks with full restore rehearsals.
missions.challenges: Shared key provider failure; stale key escrow; dependency cycle; unavailable operator.
missions.falsifier: Refute if all apparent gains depend on impossible simultaneous availability or unchecked backup consistency.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: CHANDRA Drift — Ephemeral Resource Evidence
missions.hypothesis: Lineage windows improve configuration-drift attribution for short-lived resources.
missions.model: Join desired revision, creation event and observed state by stable resource identity; reason about delayed observations with validity intervals rather than last-value overwrite.
missions.experiment: Synthetic deployment histories plus optional owned OpenTelemetry traces; compare periodic snapshots with lineage-aware reconciliation.
missions.challenges: Reused identifiers; missed deletion; delayed collectors; eventually consistent controllers.
missions.falsifier: Refute if reported violations cannot be tied to a reviewed valid-time state or false alarms exceed a snapshot baseline.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: HUBBLE Reserve — Selective Evidence Triage
missions.hypothesis: Abstention based on evidence completeness reduces unsupported advice at a measured review cost.
missions.model: Define risk R(c) over accepted cases at coverage c; separate calibration score from evidence sufficiency. Reserve human review for low-evidence and out-of-distribution cases.
missions.experiment: Create synthetic analyst cases with source contradictions and missing evidence; compare full-coverage advice with bounded abstention at fixed human review capacity.
missions.challenges: Labels selected by previous triage; overconfidence on unfamiliar sources; changing queue load.
missions.falsifier: Refute if retained-case error does not improve or abstention overwhelms review capacity.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: WEBB Horizon — Channel-Held-Out Anomaly Study
missions.hypothesis: Channel-level holdout reveals transfer failures hidden by random timestep splits.
missions.model: Fit a predictor on train channels; calibrate threshold on validation channels; evaluate event precision, delay and per-channel confidence without point-adjustment shortcuts.
missions.experiment: Use Telemanom public SMAP/MSL telemetry after license and preprocessing review; compare persistence, robust residual and learned predictor.
missions.challenges: Operating mode confounding; label interval ambiguity; overlap from windowing; dataset age.
missions.falsifier: Refute if improvement disappears on untouched channels or whole-event credit masks most missed timestamps.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: PIONEER Balance — Physics Residual Attribution
missions.hypothesis: Mode-aware physical residuals distinguish ordinary operating transitions from model disagreement more accurately.
missions.model: Use x_(t+1)=A_m x_t+B_m u_t+w_t with mode m; calibrate innovations separately per mode. Disagreement is a fault signal, not attribution of intent.
missions.experiment: Synthetic tank/thermal process with load transitions, biased calibration and missing sensors; compare global and mode-conditioned limits.
missions.challenges: Incorrect mode label; sensor common bias; model rank deficiency; saturation.
missions.falsifier: Refute if benign mode changes dominate alarms or confidence intervals lack held-out residual coverage.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: CASSINI Safe Harbor — Recovery Reachability
missions.hypothesis: A recovery plan with physical safe-set reachability can reject digitally valid but unsafe restoration order.
missions.model: Safe set S constrains state trajectory; plan repair actions only if a bounded transition model keeps x_t in S throughout. Uncertain bounds require conservative feasibility.
missions.experiment: Offline process simulation and approved tabletop decisions; compare service-priority and constrained recovery on identical demand.
missions.challenges: Delayed actuator response; unknown state; incompatible safe sets; infeasible recovery.
missions.falsifier: Refute if any chosen plan violates S within stated model bounds, or unknown states are silently assumed safe.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: LUNAR GATEWAY Courier — Evidence Through Contact Gaps
missions.hypothesis: Evidence-aware batching improves verified freshness under finite contact and power budgets.
missions.model: Queue signed evidence metadata by mission relevance and expiry; minimize age-of-information subject to queue capacity and contact windows. Cryptography is external to the scheduling model.
missions.experiment: Supplied synthetic contact model, then cFS-compatible offline emulator; compare every-step, contact-only and expiry-prioritized schedules.
missions.challenges: Clock reset; missed window; storage exhaustion; repeated stale receipts.
missions.falsifier: Refute if claimed delivery relies on nonexistent contact or resets freshness without a verified newer receipt.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: JUNO Partition — Radiation and Trust-State Coupling
missions.hypothesis: Separating physical fault recovery from authority recovery exposes unsafe combinations of individually valid states.
missions.model: Product automaton combines device health, verified image, authority lease and link state; invariants constrain valid operational combinations.
missions.experiment: Enumerate synthetic resets and contact gaps with an owned software emulator; compare independent health and authority controllers.
missions.challenges: Recovered image with expired authority; corrupted evidence index; repeated reset; key unavailable.
missions.falsifier: Refute if any reachable state permits a mission action without required verified state; no radiation-rate claim is made.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: MERCURY Handoff — Team Memory Retention
missions.hypothesis: Structured uncertainty handoffs reduce unsupported assumptions at shift changes.
missions.model: Use crossed task/participant design; outcome combines severe decision errors, omitted uncertainty and completion time. Cluster by team for intervals.
missions.experiment: Consented tabletop crossover with task-balanced order and blinded grading; compare free-form notes with source-linked uncertainty handoff.
missions.challenges: Learning carryover; assessor bias; accessibility mismatch; team interdependence.
missions.falsifier: Refute if severe errors rise or time savings vanish after adjusting for task difficulty.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: APOLLO Console — Accessibility-Aware Alert Budgets
missions.hypothesis: Accessible evidence summaries preserve decision quality at lower cognitive workload.
missions.model: Estimate mixed effects for interface, workload and participant; primary endpoint is task correctness, with timing and workload as secondary outcomes.
missions.experiment: Consented synthetic incident tasks presented using existing and alternative accessible views; preregister meaningful effect and analyze subgroup uncertainty.
missions.challenges: Small subgroup sample; unequal information; familiarity; speed-accuracy tradeoff.
missions.falsifier: Refute if interface reduces workload scores but increases severe errors or excludes an accessibility group.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: PHOENIX Relay — Robust Recovery Scheduling
missions.hypothesis: A robust schedule reduces worst-case mission loss when repair durations are uncertain.
missions.model: Choose feasible order minimizing CVaR_alpha(L) over declared duration scenarios; compare mean-loss and tail-loss choices under identical prerequisites.
missions.experiment: Supplied six-service schedule fixture plus stochastic duration extensions; hold out extreme duration scenarios and unavailable staff.
missions.challenges: Correlated repairs; hidden prerequisites; incompatible staffing; inaccurate tail model.
missions.falsifier: Refute if tail reduction disappears outside the optimization sample or safety prerequisite is violated.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: NEW HORIZONS Restore — Evidence Before Return
missions.hypothesis: Restoration gates tied to current artifacts reduce false confidence from successful backup jobs.
missions.model: A restore certificate binds backup digest, key availability, dependency state and checked functional invariants; passing transfer integrity alone cannot certify operation.
missions.experiment: Synthetic backup manifests and owned isolated restore fixtures with deliberate staleness; compare checksum-only with function-aware evidence.
missions.challenges: Consistent but obsolete backup; lost key; incompatible schema; partial dependency restore.
missions.falsifier: Refute if the gate accepts a fixture failing its stated invariant or rejects correct restores without an explainable cause.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: NEOWISE Census — Relevance Without Targeting
missions.hypothesis: Owned inventory relevance improves defensive prioritization beyond catalog presence alone.
missions.model: Join exact ecosystem/version identity to catalog metadata; preserve unmatched and ambiguous states. KEV addition is a time-stamped positive indicator, not a negative label for absent records.
missions.experiment: Pinned CISA snapshot and entirely synthetic owned inventory; independently adjudicate ambiguous product matches and compare age-only ranking.
missions.challenges: Vendor aliases; broad product names; unknown versions; selected positives.
missions.falsifier: Refute if relevance accuracy fails manual adjudication or unmatched records are counted as safe.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: WISE Chronicle — Temporal Catalog Selection
missions.hypothesis: Catalog-addition timing should be modeled separately from exploitation onset in longitudinal evaluations.
missions.model: Treat addition date as observation process time; model interval-censored onset only when independent onset bounds exist. Avoid fitting exploitation hazards from addition dates alone.
missions.experiment: Use the pinned KEV date/vendor aggregates for descriptive analysis; a causal extension requires separate incident and disclosure evidence that is not supplied here.
missions.challenges: Delayed reporting; changing inclusion policy; duplicate or withdrawn records; survival bias.
missions.falsifier: Refute any interpretation that turns observed addition counts into population exploitation rates without a sampling model.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: JAMES WEBB Lens — Defense Effect Identifiability
missions.hypothesis: A preregistered causal diagram can expose when before/after security benefit cannot be identified.
missions.model: Y(1),Y(0) define potential outcomes; draw common causes of intervention and outcome. Estimate only with defensible overlap and adjustment, otherwise report bounded sensitivity.
missions.experiment: Simulate intervention assignment tied to prior incident rate; compare naive change, stratification and known randomized assignment.
missions.challenges: Regression to mean; simultaneous control rollout; measurement drift; interference.
missions.falsifier: Refute if the estimator recovers a benefit under null randomized outcomes or ignores absent overlap.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established

missions.title: ROMAN Observatory — Uncertainty-Aware Investment
missions.hypothesis: Value-of-information analysis can prioritize measurement work before irreversible control investment.
missions.model: Compare expected decision loss with and without a new measurement; vary prior assumptions and measurement quality. A positive VOI must exceed study cost.
missions.experiment: Synthetic control portfolio with uncertain repair, alert and mission-loss parameters; compare point-estimate purchase ranking with sequential evidence collection.
missions.challenges: Unreliable measurement; correlated parameters; model misspecification; decision delay cost.
missions.falsifier: Refute if recommended study changes no plausible decision or uncertainty reduction is mistaken for risk reduction.
missions.status: Proposed; no field effectiveness established
